verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API, webhooks, custom channels, and a hosted MCP server (with OAuth-scoped agent access confirmed via probe), giving AI-native builders real programmatic surfaces, but there is no evidence of an official client SDK (e.g. Python/JS library) and probes show no published OpenAPI spec (404s) that would normally back an SDK. Missing for 10: an actual named/downloadable SDK package, OpenAPI/schema definition, and independent confirmation of SDK usage in the wild.
